reason: The routing is right (post-deadline, no new ID), but the finding's main factual premise is wrong. Trackastra ships a pretrained 'ctc' model trained on the 2D AND 3D Cell Tracking Challenge datasets; it succeeds the winner of the ISBI 2024 CTC generalizable-linking challenge (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/weigertlab/trackastra/main/trackastra/model/pretrained.json). So the claim 'the public models are 2D or general; this is a retraining item' is false. A zero-shot trial would not break the no-retraining rule. It stays post-deadline for other reasons. (1) R8 feasibility: Trackastra needs images plus instance MASKS, and x138 outputs centroids, so pseudo-masks would be needed. It would also need an offline wheel and weights dataset on Kaggle, integration into x138's relink costs, an exp60 gate, a dummy and a new user OK, all before 27 Sep 12:00Z (~17 h away). That is not achievable honestly. (2) Value: the only error decomposition on file (CONTEXT.md l.117, l.492-494; older base, not x138) finds wrong association ~0, with losses in detection (3.6%) and fragmentation (3.1%). The relink/edge family also has the worst lab-to-LB transfer on file (edge filter +0.016 lab, 0 on LB), so an association re-score has little headroom. (3) The runtime of '+1-2 min/clip' has no source. The domain gap between CTC 3D nuclei and this data is untested.
fix: Curator: merge into I-122 as an alias (deferred-after-deadline), no new ID. Correct the rationale to: a pretrained 3D-capable Trackastra 'ctc' model exists (zero-shot possible, no retraining). It is deferred because it needs pseudo-masks from centroids, offline packaging and a lab gate, none of which fits R8. Its expected value is low because wrong association is ~0 in errdecomp and relink-family gains transfer poorly. Post-deadline, run it only after I-285 (pre-relink dump hook), as a zero-shot 'ctc' re-score of x138 relink pairs. Bar: lab gain >= 6x the target public gain. Drop the unsourced runtime figure.
realistic_gain: 0 before the deadline (infeasible under R8). After the deadline: likely <= +0.001 public, because association errors are ~0 in errdecomp and relink-family lab gains have not transferred.
